_comment: Canonical model family -> ORDERED surfaces (quota pools) that can serve it. A 'surface' is a quota-axi provider (claude/codex/grok/cursor/copilot/kimi) or a custom source in bin/quota-sources/<surface>.sh (e.g. cline). Routing/failover walks the list left-to-right and dispatches on the first surface with observable headroom; a surface whose quota is unobservable (server-side only, e.g. cursor/cline) is treated fail-open as a valid failover target. Same model, several pools: this is how 'grok from whichever pool has tokens' and 'kimi3 via cline' are expressed. Extend freely.
